Messages.Author: Pendargon
Messages.Body:
I will be coming to the city of light tomorrow evening (to make up for missing the EC), and will be staying for the next 10 days. I will try to get some games with you Parisian lot in either Troll2Jeux or Le
repaire du dragon, depending or my schedule and blatant tourism . I've been in contact with Orian Gissler, but just to let the others know!

Can't wait!
Dusan

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Hi!

We play at Troll2Jeux on Tuesday evenings and at Le Repaire du Dragon on Thursday evenings.
Both are quite easily accessible using the subway.

We were 12 tonight, and we should be around 10 on Tuesday (starting around 7 PM)

If you need any informations, feel free to send me a message!

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Pendargon
Messages.Body: Yeah, Orian was kind enough to give me the addresses and when the play begins. Since i am arriving tomorrow, it is possible that i will come to play on thursday, but we'll see, depending on other factors (my fiancee ). I'll keep in touch

Messages.Author: Pendargon
Messages.Body:
Just to say a big THANK YOU to the Parisian players! I had a great time, and although short, it was huge fun! Hope to play again with you guys sometime!

Also, a big thank to Orian, who managed to find me most of the cards i was searching for!

Stay good!
D.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
See you next time, maybe in Warsaw, who knows?

Prince of Paris, France
